issues.detail: R5 example: areset=1 forces S0 so z=x; row1 x=1 z=1 ok, row2 x=0 z=0 ok, row3 areset=0 x=0 z=0 ok. Consistent but does not demonstrate async timing.

Spec says output is 2's complement of the input number; contract implements LSB-first streaming complement (pass until first 1, then invert). Alternative semantics: complement all bits including leading zeros (pure NOT). Distinguishing sequence: x=0,0,1,0 LSB-first.
issues.spec_evidence: the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input
issues.alternative: Pure bitwise NOT of every input bit (z=NOT x always), ignoring first-1 detection.

issues.detail: Spec says conversion stops when Reset asserted; contract only forces state S0, so z still follows x during reset. Alternative: z held/zero during reset. Distinguishing sequence: areset=1 with x=1.
issues.spec_evidence: The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.
issues.alternative: During areset=1, z is forced to 0 (conversion stopped) rather than passing x.

issues.detail: R1/R2 spec_quote 'the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input' does not verbatim support per-state pass/complement behavior; quote is indirect.
issues.spec_evidence: the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input
